overview.title: Platform overview
overview.description: Every school on Studafy at a glance. This console runs the platform; each school's own admin console runs only that school.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.description: Schools that used "Talk to us" on the website. Each one is also emailed to the sales inbox set in Platform settings.
inquiries.newCount_one: {{count}} new inquiry waiting for a reply.
inquiries.newCount_other: {{count}} new inquiries waiting for a reply.
inquiries.caption: Sales inquiries

detail.notes: Internal notes (only the Studafy team sees these)

finance.title: Platform finance
finance.description: What Studafy earns from schools: recurring revenue, renewal charges, and the schools whose billing needs attention. A school's own tuition billing lives in that school's finance console.
finance.mrrNote: At list price, from each billed school's plan in its currency. Discounts and yearly billing are not reflected.
finance.attentionHelp: Overdue or in grace, paused, cancelling at period end, or a trial ending within 14 days.
finance.attentionEmpty: Every school's billing is in good standing.

ai.title: AI usage & margin
ai.description: AI usage, provider cost and add-on revenue per school for the current billing period.
ai.period: AI usage, provider cost and add-on revenue per school, {{start}} – {{end}}.
ai.empty: No school has AI subscriptions this period.
ai.caption: AI usage by school

schools.title: Schools
schools.description: Every school on the platform. Open one to change its lifecycle or its feature flags.
schools.caption: Schools on the platform

members.title: Members
members.description: Every account in this school. Viewing this list is recorded in the audit log of this school and of yours.
members.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, member ID, admission or employee number
members.caption: Members of {{school}}

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.terminal: Archived schools are permanent and cannot be changed.

explain.pending: This school has registered but is not live yet. Activate it to open the school for use.
explain.active: This school is live. Suspending blocks sign-in for everyone except its admins and finance staff.
explain.suspended: This school is suspended: its users cannot sign in, and students' AI subscriptions are paused.

consequence.active: The school's users can sign in again. If it was suspended, students' AI subscriptions resume billing.
consequence.suspended: Teachers, students and parents can no longer sign in, and students' AI subscriptions are paused at the payment provider. You can reactivate the school later.
consequence.archived: The school is closed permanently. This cannot be undone, and students' AI subscriptions stop billing.

lifecycle.reasonHelp: Recorded in the audit log of this school and of yours.
lifecycle.confirmNameLabel: Type the school's name to confirm: {{name}}
lifecycle.aiSyncFailed: The status changed, but updating AI billing failed. Repeat the same action to retry.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Override a platform feature for this school only. Changes take effect within seconds.

plans.title: Plans & pricing
plans.description: What schools pay Studafy. Changes are saved here first; sync to publish them to Stripe.
plans.syncSuccess: Synced {{plans}} plans and {{prices}} prices with Stripe.
plans.syncReminder: Run “Sync with Stripe” afterwards so checkout shows the new name.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: Values the whole platform runs with. Locked settings change only through a migration.
settings.caption: Platform settings
settings.restartNotice: This setting takes effect after the next deploy or restart.

users.title: Account lookup
users.description: Find every account a person holds across all schools. Exact email match only.
users.hint: Enter an email to see which schools it has an account in.
users.caption: Accounts for {{email}}
users.empty: No account uses this email in any school.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Refund requests for school plans and AI add-ons. Approving one refunds the payment through the provider that took it.
refunds.caption: Refund requests
refunds.empty: No refund requests match these filters.
refunds.noteLabel: Note to the requester (required to reject)

approve.heading: Decision
approve.paymentsUnavailable: Couldn't load the school's payments from the provider.
approve.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero and no more than the payment.
approve.cancelLabel: Also cancel the school's subscription at the end of its period

reject.noteRequired: Write a note for the requester first.

cancellation.scheduled: Refund issued. The subscription will cancel at the end of its period.
cancellation.already_scheduled: Refund issued. The subscription was already set to cancel.
cancellation.failed: Refund issued, but the subscription couldn't be cancelled. Cancel it from the school's billing page.

applications.title: School applications
applications.description: Schools that signed up on the website with Google or Microsoft. Check the proof of ownership, then approve to create the school or reject with a reason. The applicant is emailed either way.
applications.caption: School sign-up applications

detail.name: Name
detail.openProof: Open the file in a new tab
detail.proofUnavailable: File storage is not configured, so the file cannot be shown.
detail.decisionExplain: Approving creates the school, makes the applicant its administrator, and starts the free trial. They sign in with the same account they applied with.

approve.title: Approve {{school}}?
approve.description: The school is created and {{email}} becomes its administrator. They will be emailed.
approve.label: Internal note (optional)

reject.title: Reject {{school}}?
reject.description: {{email}} will be emailed this reason and can apply again.
reject.label: Reason (sent to the applicant)

errors.generic: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
errors.SCHOOL_APPLICATION_NOT_PENDING: This application has already been reviewed. Reload to see the decision.
errors.SCHOOL_APPLICATION_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: The applicant's sign-in account already belongs to a Studafy user, so it cannot become this school's administrator.
errors.SCHOOL_EMAIL_DUPLICATE: A school with this email already exists.
